recommendation.text: The Board recommends that the Administration submit a proposal to the Working Group on Contingent-Owned Equipment, for consideration by the General Assembly, that performance criteria be included in the memorandums of understanding with the Member States. The Board recommends that the Administration also submit a proposal to the Working Group on Contingent- Owned Equipment, for consideration by the Assembly, to the effect that performance criteria shall be linked to the reimbursement rates.
